requirements.description: Clone the exact current or historical dataset version with all business fields and original data
Generate a new dataset ID and stable item IDs while preserving visible case IDs
Start the copy at v1 with one source record and visible copiedFrom metadata
Exclude linked projects, tasks, votes, generation jobs, sync summaries, and source history
Expose matching POST API and localStorage clone behavior through one pure builder
Provide collision-aware naming, historical-version context, guarded submission, auto-selection, and provenance display
Cover deterministic cloning, API errors/source isolation, refresh persistence, and desktop/mobile browser flows
